hypotheses.construction_plan: Define a one-parameter template T_phi(n)=K(n)*phi(n). Obtain the first summand by specializing phi to a, and the second summand by specializing phi to b.
required_assumptions: K, a, and b are functions of the same variable n
hypotheses.rationale: Both terms share the identical factor K(n) and differ only in the trailing function factor a(n) versus b(n), so they are instances of a single parameterized multiplicative family.
